content:
Hey all!

I've recently started learning rust and hoping to contribute to rust for linux someday. I was reading https://rust-for-linux.com/contributing, and got a little bit of confusion. The page mentions both Github issues and mailing list. I'm having confusion understanding which one is used for which. Right now my understanding is that Github is being used for issue tracking and mails for actual submission and review.
I wanted to know if I'm getting this right or not.

Thanks!
To be clear, our GitHub is for our subsystem, i.e. RUST -- issues for other subsystems should go to their own trackers (or whatever they use, it could be just the mailing list).
(It is fine if we get sometimes something that is not for ourselves; we can redirect it, i.e. in case of doubt, just submit it to wherever it looks like it makes the most sense)
I recommend reading the MAINTAINERS file -- that is the place that gives you all the trackers and websites and guidelines for each subsystem, etc.
